title: Brokerage master (BOW front end, BROKERAGE MASTER)
purpose: The firm's brokerage plans for BOW's charge estimates: one line per plan rate line in force on the date, for the BOW channel (Connections → BOW upload files, default online, else the all-channels line), with STT, transaction charges, GST, SEBI fee and stamp duty from the charge schedule. Ledgerline's plan modes map to BOW's types: percent 1, flat per order 2, lower of flat and percent 3, percent with a minimum per order 4, per lot 5, no brokerage 1 with 0. Lines BOW cannot express (per share, a maximum per order, minimums per share, lot or contract note, settlement cases such as expiry, scrip groups) are left out and listed in the note. BOW's sheet shows its sample in columns; the file is comma-separated like BOW's other uploads. BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.

columns.name: PlanName
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The brokerage plan's name in Ledgerline (commas removed)

columns.name: Exchange
columns.note: BSE, NSE, MCX, NCDEX: the rate line's exchange, or each exchange the firm trades the segment on for a line for all exchanges

columns.name: Market
columns.note: EQUITY, DERIVATIVES, CURRENCY, COMMODITIES

columns.name: Segment
columns.note: EQUITY, FUTURES or OPTIONS

columns.name: Instrument_Series_Name
columns.note: Series or group for cash; the instrument for derivatives (FUTIDX, FUTSTK, OPTIDX, OPTSTK on NSE; IF, SF, IO, SO on BSE) for lines for index or stock derivatives only; blank = all

columns.name: ProductId
columns.note: INTRA, CNC or ALL: CM intraday INTRA, CM delivery CNC, derivatives ALL

columns.name: Symbol
columns.note: A line for one scrip or underlying only

columns.name: Buy BrokerageType
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 1 % of value per order, 2 flat per order, 3 lower of % and flat, 4 higher of % and the amount, 5 flat per lot, 6 monthly or yearly charge

codes.3: Minimum of % or flat per order
codes.4: Maximum of % or flat per order

columns.name: Value1_Buy
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The percent (0.03 = 0.03%)

columns.name: Value2_Buy
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The rupee amount

columns.name: Sell BrokerageType
columns.note: As Buy BrokerageType

columns.name: STT_CTT_Buy
columns.note: STT / CTT on buys, % (charge schedule)

columns.name: STT_CTT_Sell
columns.note: STT / CTT on sells, % (charge schedule)

columns.name: Tran_Charges
columns.note: Exchange transaction charges, % (charge schedule)

columns.name: GST
columns.note: GST % (charge schedule)

columns.name: SEBI Charges
columns.note: SEBI fee, % (₹10 a crore = 0.0001; charge schedule)

columns.name: StampChargesType
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 1 % of value

columns.name: StampCharges Value1
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Stamp duty on buys, % (charge schedule)

columns.name: StampCharges Value2
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 0

columns.name: Buy DP_Clearing_Type
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 1 % of value, 2 flat per order, 3 lower of, 4 higher of. 1 with 0: no DP charge on buys

columns.name: Buy DP_Clearing_Value1
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 0

columns.name: Buy DP_Clearing_Value2
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 0

columns.name: Sell DP_Clearing_Type
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 2 (flat per order) with the firm's DP charge per sell on delivery lines (Connections → BOW upload files); 1 with 0 otherwise

columns.name: Sell DP_Clearing_Value1
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 0

columns.name: Sell DP_Clearing_Value2
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The DP charge per sell, ₹

columns.name: BM_Disclaimer_Message1
columns.note: 50 characters at most (Connections → BOW upload files)

columns.name: BM_Disclaimer_Message2
columns.note: 50 characters at most

columns.name: BM_Disclaimer_Message3
columns.note: 50 characters at most

columns.name: DELETE_FLAG
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Y delete the plan; N (or anything else) add or update
